TJpgDec R0.03 (C)ChaN 2021, http://elm-chan.org/fsw/tjpgd/ - taken from
https://github.com/Bodmer/TJpg_Decoder (which adds a byte-swap flag for
RGB565 output; unused here). Configured in tjpgdcnf.h: RGB888 output, no
descaling, JD_FASTDECODE 1 (3.5 KB work area). Licence: see the notice at
the top of tjpgd.c.
